text.p: Designs Inc Tuesday said it is restructuring to try to save approximately $1.5 million in 1997 -- excluding severance, benefits, and other related costs -- and at least $3.0 million in 1998.
Designs Inc said it will refocus the product mix in its Designs and Boston Trading Co stores to one focused on privately held Levi Strauss & Co and other brand name apparel and accessories.

As part of the restructuring, Designs said it plans to shut its New York private label product development office and lay off "all headcount associated with that office." The company said it instituted a a headcount freeze in its home office and does not intend to replace open home office positions through the balance of 1997. It did not say how many jobs were affected and no one was available for comment.

"We are going back to basics by returning to our core competency of operating specialty retail stores featuring Levi's, Dockers and other name brands and will use private label only to fill voids in key product categories not covered by these brands," said chief executive officer Joel Reichman.
